input.answer:
The overall Food index (CPI, Canada, not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100) rose by about 2.2% from September 2025 to September 2026.

Calculation: (201.8 − 197.5) / 197.5 × 100 = 4.3 / 197.5 × 100 = 2.18%, which rounds to 2.2%.

The series is the "Food" product group (member id 3 in table 18-10-0004), which is the parent of "Food purchased from stores" and covers food from stores and restaurants. The data are for September 2025 and September 2026, the latest month available in the table.

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Percent change in the overall Food CPI, Canada, not seasonally adjusted, from 2025-09 (197.5) to 2026-09 (201.8)
